_comment: Mock breast patient for manual RAG testing. DELIBERATELY INCOMPLETE.
Anchored: firstName, age, sex, site and stage. Enough that cancer_slug
resolves to 'breast' before turn one — otherwise the model gets the wrong
overlay and the home screen sits in cancer-picker mode.
Empty on purpose: biomarkers, treatments, zipCode, histology, symptoms,
ecog. Those are exactly the fields question_policy ranks highest, so the
chat has to ASK for them. A complete profile scores high on coverage, jumps
the lifecycle straight to trial_ready, makes select_next_question return
None on every turn, and leaves extraction nothing to reconcile — you would
never see a getting-to-know-you question, a confirmation chip, or a stage
advance, which ARE the progression being tested.
